userStories.title: Record remediation evidence

Its only warning names Tasks; npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities.
Its dependency tree contains no shell-quote, and published guard bundles contain no shell-quote identifiers.
The committed transcript records commands, observed results, and verification limits.
